name: model
desc: Show or switch the model

name: mode
desc: Show or switch the permission mode

name: ask
desc: Read-only Q&A, one shot: no changes

name: plan
desc: Plan mode: research read-only, write a plan

name: code
desc: Normal mode: all tools, normal prompts

name: normal
desc: Switch to normal mode

name: accept-edits
desc: Edits apply right away; commands still ask

name: smart
desc: Edits auto-approved; a judge model screens commands

name: bypass
desc: Auto-approve everything (deny rules still apply)

name: fast
desc: Use the fast model for this prompt

name: loop
desc: Run, then review the diff and repeat until approved

name: btw
desc: Side question, not added to the conversation

name: compact
desc: Summarise older turns to free context

name: context
desc: Context window usage

name: usage
desc: Calls and estimated tokens this session

name: clear
desc: Start a fresh session

name: continue
desc: Continue the latest (or a given) session

name: resume
desc: Pick a saved session to resume

name: ls
desc: List saved sessions for this workspace

name: title
desc: Rename this session

name: rm-session
desc: Delete a saved session

name: steps
desc: List the steps (user requests) so far

name: fork
desc: Branch the conversation into a new session

name: revert
desc: Undo file changes from a step and rewind to it

name: export
desc: Write the session as Markdown

name: copy
desc: Copy the last reply

name: exit
desc: Leave

name: workspace
desc: Show the workspace folders

name: add-dir
desc: Let the agent work in another folder too

name: remove-dir
desc: Stop including an added folder

name: agents
desc: List subagent definitions (and problems)

name: agent
desc: Run one subagent directly

name: help
desc: List the slash commands

name: shortcuts
desc: Keyboard shortcuts

name: config
desc: Show the current settings (never the key)
